sources.t: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q4 2025
sources.f: Published 11 May 2026; Ofcom reports complaint rates for major broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV providers in Q4 2025.
sources.g: Provider complaint rates do not establish current exact-address availability.

sources.t: Report: Complaints about broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV services
sources.f: Updated 23 July 2026; Ofcom publishes quarterly complaints per 100,000 customers and Q1 2026 trends.
sources.g: Complaint statistics are service-quality context, not parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Broadband complaints fall to record low
sources.f: Published 23 July 2026; Ofcom states broadband complaints reached six per 100,000 customers in Q1 2026.
sources.g: Low complaint rates do not prove a provider can serve a particular premises.

sources.t: Ofcom fines Virgin Media £28m for repeatedly preventing customers from cancelling contracts
sources.f: Published 8 July 2026; Ofcom records enforcement concerning contract cancellation and switching barriers.
sources.g: Enforcement evidence does not establish broadband coverage or orderability.

sources.t: Quicker complaints resolution for telecoms customers, under new Ofcom rules
sources.f: Ofcom reduced the ADR access threshold from eight weeks to six, effective 8 April 2026.
sources.g: Complaint-resolution rules are not service availability evidence.

sources.t: Switching mobile, broadband or landline
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; Ofcom explains Text to Switch and One Touch Switch processes.
sources.g: Switching procedure guidance does not prove an address is serviceable.

sources.t: Switching broadband provider
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; the guide explains broadband switching through One Touch Switch.
sources.g: A switching workflow does not establish current network reach.

sources.t: Switching mobile phone provider
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; Ofcom explains PAC, STAC and contract-status text services.
sources.g: Mobile switching guidance is not fixed-broadband parcel evidence.

sources.t: Switching landline provider
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; Ofcom explains One Touch Switch for landline services and compensation safeguards.
sources.g: Landline switching rules do not prove broadband orderability at a premises.

sources.t: Telecoms price rises – what are your rights?
sources.f: Updated 29 June 2026; Ofcom explains pounds-and-pence price-rise rules for new contracts and exit rights.
sources.g: Contract pricing rights are not exact-address connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Broadband speeds: what you need to know
sources.f: Ofcom provides consumer guidance on broadband speed commitments and switching where guaranteed speeds are not met.
sources.g: Speed guidance and guarantees require an actual service contract and are not parcel coverage proof.

sources.t: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026
sources.f: Published 1 May 2026 and closed 1 June 2026; BDUK sought national existing and three-year planned gigabit infrastructure submissions.
sources.g: OMR submissions and plans are not current retail orderability evidence.

sources.t: Closure of the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.f: Updated 1 June 2026; the notice confirms closure of the May 2026 national infrastructure data request.
sources.g: A consultation closure does not validate service at an individual UPRN.

sources.t: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review January 2026
sources.f: Published 6 January 2026 and updated 10 June 2026; BDUK records the January OMR and regional outputs.
sources.g: National and regional OMR classification is planning evidence, not live parcel truth.

sources.t: Kent Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the notice records public-review classifications, intervention-area methodology and procurement context.
sources.g: White, grey, black and under-review classifications require fresh exact-premises validation.

sources.t: Suffolk (Lot 2) Public Review Closure Notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; BDUK publishes Suffolk public-review outcomes and intervention-area annexes.
sources.g: Public-review outcome records are not current provider order checks.

sources.t: Hampshire (Lot 27) Public Review Closure Notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; BDUK records Hampshire public-review outcomes and proposed intervention areas.
sources.g: Proposed intervention scope does not prove completed broadband service.

sources.t: Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire and East of Berkshire Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the notice records public-review methodology and subsequent contract redesign context.
sources.g: Historic classifications and redesigned scope are not live parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Cambridgeshire and adjacent areas (Lot 5) Public Review Closure Notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; BDUK records the Lot 5 public-review outcome and redesigned contract context.
sources.g: Procurement and intervention records do not establish active service at an address.

sources.t: UK Gigabit Programme: Norfolk Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the official consultation page indexes the Norfolk closure notice, maps and postcode outputs.
sources.g: Consultation outputs and postcode classifications require current provider and UPRN verification.
